newsitem.title: USA: McCrory Corp gets $35 mln financing from Foothill.
newsitem.headline: McCrory Corp gets $35 mln financing from Foothill.

text.p: McCrory Corp said on Tuesday it arranged for $35 million of debtor-in-possession financing from Foothill Capital Corp.
The money will be used among other purposes to refinance $11 million owed to McCrory's current debtor-in-possession lender, the CIT Group/Business Credit Inc, McCrory said.

Foothill made the financing contingent upon it receiving a participation agreement from McCrory's chairman and chief executive, Meshulam Riklis, or one of his affiliates, for at least $10 million. Riklis has agreed, McCrory said.
The Foothill agreement is subject to U.S. Bankruptcy Court approval. McCrory filed under Chapter 11 of the Bankruptcy Code in February 1992.
